spec.title: Fragile-part placement and traceability
spec.instruction: Prepare one large part and two small parts, and identify all three using a shared scanner. Arrange the two small-part inserts separately and place the large part on the central tray using both units. Print three traceability labels with a shared printer. Label and place each part in its assigned area, then combine the batch records.
